title: fix(rest): GET /meta/diagnostics refuses an unknown type, severity or package, and keys an alias by its canonical type (#27514)

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu5mq5spkb2GMJ5SN6jEWmDk)_

Fixes #27514

Clause-②: no (narrowing — owes one contract-review-tier review before the queue)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #27632

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：诊断接口 `GET /meta/diagnostics` 遇到不认识的类型、严重级别或包，不再回 200「全部正常」，而是回 400 并说明原因；用别名（如 `views`）查询时统计按标准类型名（`view`）给出；该接口所有拒绝统一成一种错误信封。
- **为什么改**：这个接口是作者、AI 和 CI 判断元数据是否健康的依据。拼错类型或包名时它回「扫描 1 个类型，0 个问题」，调用方会误以为一切正常。
- **风险与回滚**：只收窄这一个只读接口的请求面，合法请求的响应形状和键集不变（别名请求的统计键从别名改为标准名，是本卡要求的变化）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/rest/src/meta-collection-routes.ts`（诊断路由：severity 校验、类型拒绝、统一信封）；`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-diagnostics.ts`（未知包拒绝、标准类型键）；`packages/rest/src/rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts`，预期 11 个用例全部通过。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地（落地前需一次 contract-review-tier 评审）。

## What changes

Measured on `main` @ `556f3230` through the real route (a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` over a real `SchemaRegistry`), every premise on the card held:

| query | before | after |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `?type=zzz_unknown` | 200, `scannedTypes: 1`, `stats.zzz_unknown` zeros | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` |
| `?severity=bogus` | 200, read as the error sweep | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` |
| `?package=com.nope.missing` | 200, zeros for all 30 swept types | 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` |
| `?type=views` | 200, `stats` and `entries` keyed `views` | 200, keyed `view`, byte-equal to `?type=view` |
| `?type=viewes` (#8924) | 400 flat `{ error: '…', code }` | 400 nested `{ error: { code, message } }`, same message |
| `?type=view&type=object` (#6877) | 400 nested `VALIDATION_ERROR` | unchanged |

- **severity** (route): `error` or `warning`; an empty value keeps the default, as an empty `type` keeps the full sweep.
- **type** (route): after the sweep, the route asks the list door's own verdict, `refuseUnknownMetaListType` (the static spelling contract, then the live type set from `getMetaTypes`), so `GET /meta/:type` and the diagnostics door agree on which names are types, and a plugin type the deployment carries live still answers. Asked after the sweep so the #8924 near-miss refusal, which names the spellings the caller reached for, keeps answering first.
- **package** (sweep): refused only when the sweep found no item bound to it AND the installed-package listing (`getMetaItems` of type `package`, the registry's records) does not carry it. An installed package with no items still answers its zeros, and rows bound to an uninstalled package are still swept. Fails open when the listing cannot be read.
- **alias key** (sweep): a named type is swept and keyed under `canonicalMetaUrlType(type)`, the fold `canonicalMetaType` applies at every `/meta` entry point. A spelling the fold does not map (`viewes`, `fieldz`) is unchanged, so the #8924 refusal still sees what the caller wrote.
- **one envelope** (route): every `400 INVALID_REQUEST` the route throws or receives now leaves in the nested `{ error: { code, message } }` its repeated-parameter refusal already used (message bounded by `truncateClientMessage`). Everything else keeps `handleRouteError`. Every code is an existing ledgered one (`INVALID_REQUEST`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`); no new code, nothing in `packages/spec`.

`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` is untouched: the package check uses `getMetaItems`, which `MetaDiagnosticsHost` already carries.

## Tests

- New `packages/rest/src/rest-meta-diagnostics-unknown-params.test.ts` (11 cases, through the HTTP route): the three refusals, both envelope cases, the alias case, and six preservation cases (`severity` warning/error/empty/absent, an installed package, `package=all`, an installed package with no items, items bound to an uninstalled package, a live plugin type). On `main`: 5 failed, 6 passed. On this branch: 11 passed.
- Two existing pins moved, both the alias key this card retires: `protocol.diagnostics-store-outage.test.ts` (`stats.fields` to `stats.field`) and `rest-server-meta-read-org-scope.test.ts` (`stats.views` to `stats.view`, plus `stats.views` absent).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol test`: 279 files passed, 21781 tests passed. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test`: 335 files passed, 6589 tests passed. `typecheck` on both packages: exit 0.
- Ablation, one leg per pin, each through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor hit 1 to 0, restore blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty): severity check, type verdict, envelope writer (all three in `rest` src, read by the test from source), and the package refusal and canonical key (in `metadata-protocol`, which the test reads from `dist/`: rebuilt, `ablation-dist-preflight` marker present exit 0, then rebuilt again and `--absent` exit 0). Each leg turned exactly its own pins red: severity 1, type 1, envelope 4, package 1, alias 1.

## Acceptance notes

- `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` gains the new rig's `findOne` double (written by `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write`); the rig opens `findOne` with `assertEngineFindOnePredicate`. That ledger is outside the claimed file surface and is the gate's own bookkeeping for the new test.
- With `?type=X&package=P`, the package refusal reads the swept types only, so an uninstalled `P` whose orphan rows are all of other types is refused with that type filter. Without the filter the full sweep finds them.
- The branch name is the card thread's harness-pinned `claude/project-thread-nx5qkr`, not `claude/issue-27514-…`; the claim records it.
